response.sql:
WITH album_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Bytes END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END) AS bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Bytes END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END) AS avg_rate
  FROM Track
)
SELECT
  a.AlbumId,
  a.avg_unit_price,
  a.bytes_per_ms,
  a.bytes_per_ms - o.avg_rate AS difference
FROM album_stats a
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "Ignore missing values in averages" applies to the bytes-per-millisecond ratio by excluding tracks with NULL Bytes from both the sum of bytes and sum of milliseconds (not double-counting milliseconds when bytes are missing).
"The average rate across all albums" means the global bytes-per-millisecond ratio computed from all tracks in the entire table, not the arithmetic mean of the per-album rates.

alternatives.interpretation: "The average rate across all albums" refers to the mean of the per-album bytes-per-millisecond rates (averaging the ratios), rather than the global ratio from all tracks.
alternatives.sql:
WITH album_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Bytes END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END) AS bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
)
SELECT
  a.AlbumId,
  a.avg_unit_price,
  a.bytes_per_ms,
  a.bytes_per_ms - AVG(a.bytes_per_ms) OVER () AS difference
FROM album_stats a
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
